title: 👀 Appearance adjectives & Possessive adjectives (my/your/his/her)
description: Учим внешность, притяжательный падеж (чей?), вопросительное слово whose и повелительное наклонение. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

days.title: Day 1: Appearance — Hair and Eyes
days.description: Учим описывать внешность: волосы и глаза

grammar.title: Appearance — Hair and Eyes
grammar.rule:
Чтобы описать внешность человека, используем:

👧 Hair (волосы): long — длинные, short — короткие, curly — кудрявые, straight — прямые, blonde — светлые, brown — коричневые, black — чёрные, red — рыжие

👀 Eyes (глаза): blue — голубые, green — зелёные, brown — карие, grey — серые

🎯 Структура:
✅ She has got long blonde hair.
✅ He has got short brown hair and blue eyes.
✅ I have got curly red hair.

🎯 Мем: 'I have got brown hair. My mum says it's dirty blonde. It's brown, Mum!' 😂
examples: Leo: 'I have got short brown hair and brown eyes. Very boring.' 🟤
Mia: 'She has got long blonde hair and blue eyes. Like a princess!' 👸
Sam: 'He has got curly red hair. People call him a carrot.' 🥕😭
grammar.keywords: long, short, curly, straight, blonde, brown, black, red, blue, green, brown, grey, have got

vocabulary.example: My sister has got curly hair.

exercises.question: What do you call hair that is not straight? 🐑
People with red hair are sometimes called 'carrots'.
exercises.explanation: Yes, Sam says people call him a carrot! 🥕

grammar.title: Appearance — Height and Build
grammar.rule:
Продолжаем описывать внешность:

📏 Рост (height): tall — высокий, short — низкий, medium height — среднего роста

🏋️ Телосложение (build): thin — худой, plump — полный, athletic — спортивный, well-built — крепкого телосложения

🎯 Структура:
✅ He is tall and thin.
✅ She is short and plump.
✅ My brother is athletic.

🎯 Мем: 'I am tall... when I stand on my bed.' 🛏️😅
examples: Leo: 'I am medium height and thin. I want to be tall!' 📏
Mia: 'My dad is tall and well-built. He plays basketball.' 🏀
Sam: 'My little brother is short and plump. He's like a little potato.' 🥔
grammar.keywords: tall, short, medium height, thin, plump, athletic, well-built

vocabulary.example: Her brother is tall and thin.
My grandmother is short and plump.

exercises.question: Which word describes someone who is not thin? 🐻
A basketball player is usually ___ . (tall / short)
My grandpa is short and ___ . (thin / plump)
Someone who is 'athletic' is good at sports.

grammar.title: Possessive ('s) and Whose
grammar.rule:
Притяжательный падеж показывает, КОМУ ЧТО-ТО ПРИНАДЛЕЖИТ.

📌 Добавляем 's к имени или существительному:
✅ This is Leo's phone. — Это телефон ЛЕО.
✅ That is Mia's bag. — Это сумка МИИ.
✅ My brother's room is a mess. — Комната МОЕГО БРАТА — беспорядок.

📌 Для множественного числа (оканчивается на s) добавляем только апостроф:
✅ My parents' car is red. — Машина МОИХ РОДИТЕЛЕЙ красная.
✅ The girls' bags are here. — Сумки ДЕВОЧЕК здесь.

📌 Вопрос whose (чей?):
❓ Whose phone is this? — Чей это телефон?
✅ It's Leo's. — Лео.

🎯 Мем: 'Whose pizza is this? — It's MINE. Don't touch!' 🍕
examples: Leo: 'Whose charger is this? — It's Sam's. He always forgets it.' 🔋
Mia: 'My sister's hair is blonde. My hair is brown. We are different!' 👩
Sam: 'My parents' car is old. My grandparents' car is new. Unfair!' 🚗

exercises.question: How do you say that the phone belongs to Leo? 📱
My ___ (parents) car is blue.
exercises.explanation: Parents' car — машина родителей (апостроф после s)! 🚗

exercises.question: For plural nouns ending in s, we add 's.
exercises.explanation: For plurals ending in s, we add just an apostrophe: parents' car 🚗

grammar.title: Imperative — Commands and Requests
grammar.rule:
Повелительное наклонение используется для КОМАНД, ПРОСЬБ и ИНСТРУКЦИЙ.

📌 Для команды используем глагол без to:
✅ Sit down! — Сядь!
✅ Open your book! — Открой книгу!
✅ Listen to me! — Слушай меня!

📌 Для вежливой просьбы добавляем please:
✅ Please close the door. — Пожалуйста, закрой дверь.
✅ Sit down, please. — Садись, пожалуйста.

📌 Для отрицания используем Don't:
❌ Don't run! — Не бегай!
❌ Don't touch my phone! — Не трогай мой телефон!

🎯 Мем: 'Don't wake me up. I'm sleeping. Please.' 😴
examples: Mum: 'Don't forget to do your homework!' 📚
Leo: 'Please don't eat my pizza. It's mine!' 🍕
grammar.keywords: imperative, commands, don't, please, sit down, open, close, listen

vocabulary.example: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.

exercises.question: What does the teacher say to start the lesson? 📖
exercises.explanation: Teacher says: 'Open your book' — откройте книгу! 📖

exercises.question: What do you say when you want someone to be silent? 🤫
___ (Close / Open) the door. It's cold outside! 🥶
'Please' is used to make a command more polite.
exercises.explanation: Yes! Please makes commands more polite! 🙏

grammar.title: Revision: Appearance, Possessive, Imperative
grammar.rule:
Сегодня проверяем себя! 🎯

📌 Внешность: long/short/curly/straight hair, blonde/brown/black/red hair, blue/green/brown eyes, tall/short, thin/plump/athletic
📌 Притяжательный падеж: Leo's phone, parents' car, Whose bag?
📌 Повелительное наклонение: Open your book! Don't run! Please sit down.

🎯 Структура: 'Whose curly hair is this? — It's Mia's.'
examples: Whose blue eyes are those? — They are my sister's. She has got beautiful eyes. 💙
Don't eat my pizza! It's Leo's! 🍕
Open your notebook and describe your best friend's appearance. 📓

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence: 👧
options: She has got long blonde hair.
She has got blonde long hair.
She has got hair long blonde.
She have got long blonde hair.
exercises.correct: She has got long blonde hair.
exercises.explanation: Прилагательные в английском идут в определённом порядке: длинные, потом цвет! 👧

exercises.question: Whose bag is this? 🎒
exercises.explanation: My sister's bag — сумка моей сестры! 🎒

exercises.question: ___ (Whose / Who's) hat is this? 🧢
exercises.explanation: Whose — чей? (не путай с who's = who is)! 🧢

exercises.question: She have got curly hair.
exercises.explanation: She has got, не have got! 👩

days.title: Day 6: Reading — The Lost and Found Mystery
days.description: Читаем детективную историю о потерянных вещах

grammar.title: Reading: The Lost and Found Mystery
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем историю о том, как Leo, Mia и Sam расследуют, кому принадлежат потерянные вещи. Используем whose, 's и imperative!

exercises.question: What was in the first mystery box? 📦
exercises.explanation: The first box had a hat inside.
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🕵️ THE LOST AND FOUND MYSTERY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 SCENE: School Lost and Found office. Three boxes of lost items.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEO: 'Look! Three mystery boxes! Let's find out who they belong to!'

MIA: 'Open the first box, Leo.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Leo opens Box 1)

LEO: 'A hat! A red baseball cap. Whose hat is this?'

MIA: 'There's a name inside: SAM.'

SAM: 'Hey! That's my hat! Where was it?'

LEO: 'In the Lost and Found. Don't lose it again!'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Box 2)

MIA: 'Open it, Sam.'

SAM: (opens) 'A pair of glasses. Whose glasses are these?'

LEO: 'Try them on, Sam.'

SAM: (puts on glasses) 'Everything is blurry! These aren't mine.'

MIA: 'Whose are they? They have flowers on the frame. They look like...'

LEO: 'They're Ms. Johnson's! I've seen her wear them!'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Box 3)

MIA: 'Last box! Open it, Leo.'

LEO: (opens) 'A notebook. A pink notebook with a cat on the cover. Whose notebook is this?'

SAM: 'Open it and look inside.'

LEO: (opens) 'It's Mia's! Look — it has her name on the first page!'

MIA: 'MY notebook! I thought I lost it forever!'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEO: 'Don't lose your things again, guys!'

SAM: 'Be quiet, Leo! You lose your phone every week!'

LEO: 'That's different. My phone is special.'

MIA: 'Please close the boxes. We're done.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SAM: 'Whose turn is it to return Ms. Johnson's glasses?'

EVERYONE looks at LEO.

LEO: 'Why me?'

MIA: 'Because you found them. Don't be lazy!'

LEO: (sighs) 'Fine. But next time, it's your turn.' 👓

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

exercises.question: Whose hat was in Box 1? 🧢
exercises.explanation: The hat had SAM written inside. It was Sam's hat!

exercises.question: What was in Box 2? 👓
exercises.explanation: Box 2 had a pair of glasses with flowers on the frame.

exercises.question: Whose notebook was in Box 3? 📓
exercises.explanation: The notebook had Mia's name on the first page!

exercises.question: Who lost their phone every week? 📱
exercises.explanation: Sam says: 'You lose your phone every week!' to Leo.

exercises.question: The glasses belonged to Leo.
exercises.explanation: The glasses belonged to Ms. Johnson, not Leo! 👓

exercises.question: Leo was happy to return Ms. Johnson's glasses.
exercises.explanation: Leo sighed and said 'Fine. But next time, it's your turn.' He wasn't happy! 😒
